battle.name: 成吉思汗統一蒙古之戰
battle.brief: 鐵木真1189年於斡難河畔起兵，與札木合、克烈、乃蠻相爭十七年，勝答蘭版朱思，借金朝之力平塔塔兒，吞併泰赤烏與主兒乞，1204年察乞兒馬兀惕斬太陽汗、誅札木合，1206年於斡難河源忽里勒臺稱成吉思汗，立怯薛與千戶制，草原歸於一統。主力兵器是蒙古複合弓，十字弩則見於金與西夏邊軍。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 這場戰爭在蒙古高原內部展開，交戰的一方是孛兒只斤氏的鐵木真及其逐步吸納的草原部落聯盟，另一方是長期割據的草原諸部聯盟與各自的汗。鐵木真一方起於也速該被塔塔兒人毒殺後留下的孛兒只斤氏小帳，1189年被本部那可兒推戴為汗，旗下有四十餘名首領與大批部眾，追隨者以兀良哈、巴魯剌思、斡勒忽訥兀惕等部為多；1196年夏金朝授予他「札兀惕忽里」名號後，他開始以百夫長的編制整頓隊伍，1206年更立怯薛（自一千一百人增至一萬人），頒十進制千戶之制，把散兵游騎整為十戶、百戶、千戶的層級，軍令由汗直發，萬戶長、千夫長各領其部。對面一方先後包括札木合率領的札達蘭部與受其擁戴的泰赤烏、弘吉剌、塔塔兒聯盟（1201年被推為古兒汗），克烈部脫斡鄰勒及其子桑昆、其弟額兒客哈剌所領的勢力，西部的乃蠻部太陽汗與其子屈出律，北部的蔑兒乞部；各部以部族為單位自備屬民，牧地與牲畜就是戰力，遇戰臨時徵發騎兵，指揮多由部酋與骨老商議。此外金朝以宗主國身分站在草原北緣，章宗在位時對高原各部既徵用又羈縻，曾出兵與鐵木真合擊塔塔兒部；西夏則在東南收留克烈部餘眾，成為蒙古南進時首先撞上的定居政權。
countriesEn: This war was fought in the interior of the Mongolian plateau. On one side stood Temujin of the Borjigin and the tribal coalition he assembled step by step; on the other stood the long-rival confederations of the steppe and the khans who led them. Temujin's side began as the small encampment of the Borjigin left behind when Yesugei was poisoned by Tatars, and in 1189 he was raised as khan by his own noker, with more than forty chiefs and a great many commoners following him, drawn chiefly from the Uliqhaj, Barulas and Qolqun-uud peoples. After the Jin court granted him the title of jarughchi in the early summer of 1196 he began reorganising his men on the hundred-man basis, and in 1206 he raised the keshig (from 1,150 men to 10,000) and promulgated the decimal organization of chiliyads, reshaping loose mounted bands into units of ten, hundred and thousand; orders issued from the khan himself, and the chiliyads and jarughchis each led their own men. The opposite side comprised, in turn, the Jadarayan people of Jamukha together with the Taichiu, Khongirad and Tatar confederation that backed him (he was raised as gur khan of the coalition in 1201); the Kereit under Ong Khan, his son Sanqun and his brother Erke Khan; the Naimans in the west under Tayang Khan and his son Kuchlug; and the Merkits in the north. Each was a tribal formation that supplied its own retainers; its pastures and its herds were its fighting strength, and it called out mounted levies as occasion required, with command decided by the clan chiefs and the elders. Beside them the Jin dynasty stood on the northern rim of the plateau as overlord: under Zhangzong the Jin levied, pacified and sometimes fought the tribes of the plateau, and once campaigned jointly with Temujin against the Tatars. To the south-east Western Xia harboured the surviving Kereit and became the first settled state the Mongols struck when they turned south.
people: 鐵木真（約1162—1227），本名鐵木真，斡難河畔乞顏部孛兒只斤氏也速該與訶額侖之子；父死於塔塔兒人之毒，母攜諸子流落泰赤烏部，幼年曾藏身於鎖兒罕失剌的帳下，日後他以十二歲結拜的札木合為第一位安答，又與克烈可汗脫斡鄰勒結為安答，得其收留才站住腳跟。1187年答蘭版朱思之戰他敗於札木合，隨後約十年間可能淪為金朝屬人，1196年方復出於草原。他最親密的搭檔是異母弟合撒兒，折折運都山設伏破克烈即出其手；別勒古台則在摔跤比試中折斷主兒乞部首領不里孛闊的腰骨。旗下四駿木華黎、博爾朮、赤老溫、博爾忽與四犬者別、速不臺、忽必來、者勒蔑多出身寒微，其中只兒豁阿歹因射傷鐵木真的戰馬又坦承不諱，被改名者別。對面最硬的對手是札木合，他領袖的聯盟曾推舉他為古兒汗，1204年在察乞兒馬兀惕戰敗後被五名伴當出賣而死；克烈部的脫斡鄰勒在逃亡中被乃蠻人豁里速別赤所殺，其子桑昆逃往吐蕃；乃蠻首領太陽汗戰歿，兒子屈出律西逃。幕僚中豁兒赤是薩滿，預言鐵木真受命於天；蒙力克一家是最早投奔的老臣；塔塔統阿則以畏兀兒文字教他書寫與計數。
peopleEn: Temujin (c. 1162-1227), born Temujin, was the son of Yesugei of the Qaiyigh-Borjigin and Qo'elun of the Onon river. His father was poisoned by Tatars, his mother led the family into exile among the Taichiu, and as a boy he hid in the tent of Sorkan-Shira. His first anda, the sworn brother he took at twelve, was Jamukha; his second was Ong Khan of the Kereit, whose protection gave him a position to stand on. He lost the battle of Dalan Baljit to Jamukha in about 1187 and may then have spent some ten years as a dependent of the Jin, returning to the steppe in 1196. His closest partner was his half-brother Hasar, whose plan produced the ambush that broke the Kereit at Khuten mountain; Belgetei broke the spine of the Juchin chief Buri-boge in a staged wrestling match. His four companions, Muqali, Borchu, Chila'un and Bo'qe, and his four dogs, Jebe, Subutai, Khubilai and Jelme, were mostly of humble birth; Chilkogai shot Temujin's battle horse and confessed it without concealment, and was renamed Jebe for it. His hardest opponent was Jamukha, whose confederation had raised him to gur khan; defeated at Chakirmaut in 1204, he was betrayed by five of his companions and killed. Ong Khan of the Kereit was killed on his flight by the Naiman Qol'-sanit, who did not recognise him, and his son Sanqun fled to Tibet. Tayang Khan of the Naimans fell in battle, and his son Kuchlug escaped westward. Among the advisers, Qonggor was the shaman who declared that heaven had set Temujin's great task upon him; Menglik's family were the earliest old retainers to join; and Tutu Ta-Tung-'ao taught him to write and to count in Uyghur letters.
kits: 十字弩在本場戰爭中的位置需要說清楚：它並非草原騎兵的自帶兵器。蒙古部的投射武器是角、骨、筋、木複合而成的反曲弓，張力大、射速快，騎射時可在馬背上直接拈弓，箭鏃備倒鉤獵箭、透甲箭與作響的哨箭，箭壺與弓囊都懸在馬鞍兩側；鐵木真陣中的每一個那可兒幾乎都有一張這樣的弓，這是他能以十七年吃掉草原的物質基礎。十字弩真正的位置在戰場的南緣：金朝邊軍與西夏守軍裝備大量弩與神臂弓，射程遠、陣地射擊精準，是蒙古騎兵南進時最常遇見的對手武器；而蒙古人自己把弩手編入軍伍，是在1205年之後攻打西夏、斡羅孩與中興府的戰事中，把隨軍的漢人與回鶻工匠、弩手一併收編的結果，恰恰是1206年忽里勒臺的整編使這件事變得可能。同一時期蒙古軍用得最多的攻城器械是投石機（元人稱砲）、撞竿、雲梯、壕壘木柵、穿井坑道用的鍬斧，以及各營隨帶的攻城梯與繩索。營具則是皮帳、木杯、羊毛氈、備用弓弦與箭囊；戰馬是蒙古騎兵最吃緊的裝備，蒙古馬體型不大而耐力極強，能連續行軍數日不飲，乳與肉可隨軍畜養，鞍具、馬鎧、馬刀、馬刺一樣不少，隨軍補給靠乳酪、乾肉與大量徵發的牛羊。
kitsEn: The position of the crossbow in this war has to be stated plainly: it was not the weapon carried by the steppe horsemen. The missile arm of the Mongol people was the composite reflex bow built of horn, sinew and wood, high in tension and fast to shoot, drawn directly from the saddle while riding; its heads included barbed hunting arrows, armour-piercing arrows and whistling arrows for signalling, and both the quiver and the bow case hung at the saddle. Almost every noker in Temujin's following owned a bow of this kind, and that was the material basis on which he consumed the steppe in seventeen years. The real place of the crossbow lay on the southern rim of the battlefield. The border garrisons of the Jin and the garrisons of Western Xia carried large numbers of crossbows and heavy tension bows, accurate in the ranks and long-ranged, and these were the enemy weapons the Mongol horsemen most often met when they turned south. The Mongols themselves only took crossbowmen into their order of battle after 1205, when the campaigns against Western Xia at Orqai and Xingqing brought Han and Uyghur craftsmen and crossbowmen into their host; the reorganization of the 1206 kurultai is precisely what made that possible. The siege equipment the Mongols used most heavily in the same period was the stone-throwing engine (called pao by the Yuan), battering poles, scaling ladders, wooden palisades for trenches, picks and spades for sapping and mining, together with ladders and ropes carried in each camp. Camp equipment consisted of leather tents, wooden cups, felt, spare bowstrings and arrow bags. Horses were the tightest item of all: the Mongol horse was small but immensely tough, could march for days without water, and its milk and flesh could be taken along on campaign; saddles, horse armour, sabres and spurs were all carried, and the supply column depended on milk curds, dried meat and the large numbers of cattle and sheep levied on the way.
tactics: 蒙古戰法的骨架在此戰中成形：無固定戰線、無密集隊形，警戒靠哨騎與斥候，機動靠戰馬，衝鋒靠放箭與繞側。第一步是把敵人從營地裡趕出來，趕到自己選定的地形上去；合蘭真沙陀遭伏之後，鐵木真退到班朱尼河一帶收攏散兵、招來盟友立下盟誓，等於以時間換回對手的鬆懈，再靠合撒兒的計策在折折運都山設伏，一打就是三天三夜。其次是合縱與分割：對方是聯盟，盟約與分贖的分歧更多，鐵木真總是先把某一支部拉走或打散，再以多路騎隊同時插入各部之間，察乞兒馬兀惕一役即是追擊與包抄並用，逼得太陽汗戰歿、札木合反被部下出賣。第三是嚴格的紀律與分贖：入敵境不許縱掠，戰利品須待大汗分派，逃者死，俘獲不許私放，這些規矩使蒙古軍在敗退時能迅速重整，在勝利後能把敵部落的兵員直接併入自己的千戶編制。第四是攻守之難：蒙古部沒有攻城器械與攻城的傳統，面對城寨就遠處列陣射擊，以箭雨與騷擾逼迫敵人出城，或利用冬季封凍的河面、森林與隘路封鎖通道；直到1205年之後他們才有工匠、投石機與成建制的弩手大隊，也才第一次真正具備攻取城邑的能力。
tacticsEn: The frame of Mongol warfare was formed during this conflict: no fixed battle line and no dense formations, warning kept by mounted scouts and outriders, mobility carried by the horse, and the charge made by showering arrows and working round the flank. The first step was to drive the enemy out of his encampment and onto ground of one's own choosing. After the defeat at Qalqan Chaghad, Temujin withdrew to the Baljuna river area, gathered his scattered men, called in allies and swore the oath of the Baljuna, buying back the enemy's slackness with time; then, on Hasar's counsel, he set an ambush at Khuten mountain, and the fighting ran for three days and three nights. Second came the work of division and combination. The enemy was a confederation, and a confederation has more quarrels over oaths and shares, so Temujin always detached or broke up one of its members first and then drove several bodies of horsemen in between the various groups at once; the battle of Chakirmaut combined pursuit with encirclement and left Tayang Khan dead on the field and Jamukha betrayed by his own men. Third came strict discipline and the sharing of spoil: no plundering in enemy country, booty to be distributed by the khan, flight punishable by death, captives not to be released on private authority. Such rules let the Mongol army re-form quickly after a reverse and let it absorb the fighting men of a beaten tribe straight into its own chiliyad structure. Fourth came the difficulty of attack and defence. The Mongols had neither siege engines nor a tradition of siege: against a walled place they stood off at a distance and shot, using arrow-fall and harassment to force an enemy out, or they sealed a route with a frozen river, a forest or a narrow pass. Only after 1205 did they have craftsmen, stone-throwing engines and formed bodies of crossbowmen, and only then did they become capable in reality of taking walled towns.
data: 時間：戰爭自1189年鐵木真被推戴為汗起，至1206年忽里勒臺止，前後約十七年，其間可繫年的大戰有答蘭版朱思（約1187年，戰前敗績）、1196年夏初隨金朝合擊塔塔兒、1197年平主兒乞與泰赤烏、1201年闊亦田破札木合聯盟、1202年滅泰赤烏與塔塔兒、1203年合蘭真沙陀受挫、1203至1204年折折運都山破克烈、1204年5月察乞兒馬兀惕滅乃蠻。地名多在今蒙古國中北部的斡難河與色楞格河流域，答蘭版朱思、折折運都山與察乞兒馬兀惕的具體位置各家仍有異說，一般考定在肯特省一帶。數字：立盟誓者出自九個不同部落，其中包含基督徒、穆斯林與佛教徒；札木合曾架起七十口鍋烹殺被俘首領；鐵木真初起時有四十一名首領及大批部眾相從；札木合與脫斡鄰勒曾各出兩萬兵救援孛兒帖；乃蠻、克烈兩部的具體兵員，現存史料只作模糊記載，並無可信數目。編制：1206年怯薛由一千一百人增至一萬人，千戶制把軍隊分為十戶、百戶、千戶，後世編制史常記為九十五個千戶；每十戶出丁一名、馬一匹、牛一頭為常規徵發，戰馬與乳、肉是全軍的物質底限。
dataEn: Timing: the war runs from the year 1189, when Temujin was raised as khan, to the kurultai of 1206, a matter of some seventeen years. The datable engagements within it are the battle of Dalan Baljit (c. 1187, a reverse before the war proper), the joint campaign against the Tatars with the Jin in the early summer of 1196, the reduction of the Juchin and Taichiu in 1197, the defeat of Jamukha's confederation at Qoyiten in 1201, the destruction of the Taichiu and the Tatars in 1202, the reverse at Qalqan Chaghad in 1203, the breaking of the Kereit at Khuten mountain between 1203 and 1204, and the destruction of the Naimans at Chakirmaut in May 1204. Place: the fighting lay mostly in the valleys of the Onon and the Selenga in the north-central part of present-day Mongolia; the exact sites of Dalan Baljit, Khuten mountain and Chakirmaut remain disputed, and are generally placed in the Khentii region. Numbers: those who swore the oath came from nine different peoples, among them Christians, Muslims and Buddhists; Jamukha once set up seventy cauldrons and boiled his captives; forty-one chiefs and a great many commoners followed Temujin when he first raised his own banner; Jamukha and Ong Khan each offered twenty thousand men to recover Borte; the precise strength of the Naiman and Kereit hosts is nowhere stated in surviving sources, which give only vague impressions. Organization: in 1206 the keshig was expanded from 1,150 men to 10,000; the chiliyad system divided the army into tens, hundreds and thousands, and later organizational histories commonly give the 1206 establishment as ninety-five chiliyads. The regular levy was one warrior, one horse and one head of cattle per ten households, and horses together with milk and meat formed the material floor on which the whole army stood.
cause: 鐵木真起兵的起因不在於他有多強，而在於也速該被塔塔兒人毒殺後留下的那個破碎的孛兒只斤氏：父親一死，屬民散盡，被本部泰赤烏部拋棄，母親訶額侖靠撿拾野果、挖取草根與捕鼠維生；他殺死同母兄長別克帖兒以鞏固自己在族中的位置，靠與札木合結安答、與脫斡鄰勒結安答而兩度獲得庇護。可是草原的權力結構決定這種庇護必然短暫：每一部首領都要靠自己的屬民與牧地取得地位，鐵木真聚眾的速度、對待屬民的方式與用人之道，都被視為對草原舊秩序的威脅。札木合先在答蘭版朱思打敗他，並以架鍋烹殺首領的做法羞辱其部眾；鐵木真隨後可能淪為金朝屬人達十年，靠金朝支持才重返草原。1196年他借金朝之力平塔塔兒、幫脫斡鄰勒奪回克烈部，得到章宗授予的札兀惕忽里名號，草原貴族才開始真正視他為對手；1201年他與克烈部擊潰札木合聯盟之後，聯盟內不滿的舊首領轉而擁護札木合，企圖藉聯盟推翻孛兒只斤與克烈的同盟，聯盟的分崩與兼并遂不可逆轉。
causeEn: What set Temujin's war in motion was not his own strength but the broken Borjigin household left behind when Yesugei was poisoned by Tatars. When his father died the retainers scattered, the family was cast out by its own Taichiu kinsmen, and his mother Qo'elun kept the children alive on windfallen fruit, roots and mice; he killed his full brother Beketai to make his own position in the clan secure, and he twice found protection by making anda with Jamukha and with Ong Khan. But the power structure of the steppe made such protection necessarily brief: every chief stood on his own retainers and pastures, and the speed with which Temujin gathered followers, the way he treated his people and the men he promoted were all read as a threat to the old order of the steppe. Jamukha defeated him first at Dalan Baljit and disgraced his men by boiling captured chiefs in cauldrons; Temujin may then have spent ten years as a servant of the Jin before returning to the steppe with Jin support. In 1196 he took Jin help against the Tatars and helped Ong Khan recover the Kereit, and the title of jarughchi granted him by Zhangzong marked the moment the steppe aristocracy began to treat him as a rival. After he and the Kereit broke Jamukha's confederation in 1201, the disaffected chiefs within that confederation rallied around Jamukha and tried to use it to destroy the Borjigin-Kereit alliance, and from that point the splitting and swallowing-up of the confederation could not be reversed.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果不止於草原歸一。1206年的忽里勒臺把一個靠血緣與安答維繫的部落聯盟，改造成以十進制軍制、怯薛護衛與成文軍律（相傳為大扎撒）為骨架的國家：汗的權力不再依賴各部首領的自願效忠，而依賴可以被重新分配的千戶與軍官；四十一名首批追隨者與班朱尼河九部落的盟誓者，成了新體制的樣板，札木合所攻擊的「提拔平民擔任要職」從此成為制度，被破壞的草原貴族壟斷再也沒有恢復。此外，被吞併的塔塔兒、泰赤烏、蔑兒乞、主兒乞、克烈與乃蠻的青壯被整編進汗的部隊，其首領或被處決、或被收編，連汪古部首領阿剌兀思也只獲准保留五千名戰士，草原自此失去獨立的政治單位，進入鐵木汗家族向金、西夏與西域擴張的階段。對南方的金與西夏而言，蒙古統一意味著北方的邊患從部落劫掠變成有組織的國家戰爭，1205年之後的西夏戰事與1211年之後的蒙金戰爭，源頭都在此處；而統一的草原也第一次具備了遠征所需的兵源、馬匹與組織能力。
impactEn: The result of this war reached well beyond the unification of the steppe. The kurultai of 1206 turned a tribal league held together by blood and anda into a state built on a decimal military system, a keshig guard and a written code of law (known by tradition as the Yassa). The khan's power no longer rested on the voluntary loyalty of clan chiefs but on chiliyads and officers who could be reassigned; the forty-one first followers and the nine peoples who swore the Baljuna oath became the model of the new order, and the promotion of commoners to command that Jamukha had attacked became a standing institution, while the broken monopoly of the steppe aristocracy was never restored. Moreover, the fighting men of the absorbed Tatars, Taichiu, Merkits, Juchin, Kereit and Naimans were reorganized into the khan's host, their leaders executed or taken into service, and even the Ongut chief Arghun was allowed to keep only five thousand warriors. The steppe thereby lost its independent political units and entered the phase of expansion by the family of Temujin against the Jin, Western Xia and the western lands. For the Jin and Western Xia to the south, Mongol unification meant that the northern frontier threat changed from tribal raiding into organized state warfare; the campaigns against Western Xia after 1205 and against the Jin after 1211 both had their origin here. The unified steppe also possessed, for the first time, the manpower, horses and organization needed for distant campaigning.
result: 成吉思汗全勝。札木合的聯盟在1201年闊亦田崩解，1204年5月察乞兒馬兀惕一戰乃蠻部被徹底擊敗、太陽汗戰歿、屈出律西逃，同年蔑兒乞部被消滅、札木合被五名伴當出賣並遭處決，1203至1204年折折運都山三日三夜之後克烈部失去領袖，脫斡鄰勒被乃蠻人豁里速別赤所殺、桑昆逃往吐蕃；1206年忽里勒臺上，鐵木真在斡難河源頭稱成吉思汗，成為草原上唯一的統治者，怯薛擴至一萬人，千戶制與軍律同時頒布。蒙古人自此再無內部割據：以十倍遞增的編制可以迅速把新附騎兵編入現存部隊，以軍律維持戰利品分配與戰時秩序。對十字弩而言，這場戰爭標誌的是另一條路線的落幕：蒙古軍在1189至1206年間幾乎全靠複合弓作戰，弩只存在於金與西夏的邊軍手裡；蒙古人真正把弩手與攻城工匠編入自己的軍隊，是在1205年之後的西夏戰事中，那已屬於帝國向外擴張的階段，而不是草原統一本身。
resultEn: Genghis Khan won outright. Jamukha's confederation broke up at Qoyiten in 1201; at Chakirmaut in May 1204 the Naimans were destroyed, Tayang Khan fell, and Kuchlug fled west; later the same year the Merkits were wiped out and Jamukha was betrayed by five of his companions and put to death. After the three days and three nights of Khuten mountain between 1203 and 1204 the Kereit lost their leader, Ong Khan was killed by the Naiman Qol'-sanit and Sanqun escaped to Tibet. At the kurultai of 1206 Temujin took the title of Genghis Khan at the headwaters of the Onon and became the sole ruler of the steppe; the keshig was expanded to ten thousand men, and the chiliyad system and the military law were promulgated at the same time. From then on there was no more internal division among the Mongols: an organization increasing by tens could absorb newly submitted horsemen into existing units with speed, and the code of law held together the distribution of spoil and the order of the field. For the crossbow, this war marks the end of a different line: the Mongol army fought almost entirely with the composite bow between 1189 and 1206, and the crossbow existed only in the hands of the border troops of the Jin and Western Xia. The Mongols truly incorporated crossbowmen and siege craftsmen into their own host only in the campaigns against Western Xia after 1205, which belonged to the phase of imperial expansion, not to the unification of the steppe itself.
